context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 33 verified all new Mini App features: 1) Video Call Booking API works - POST /api/miniapp/book-video-call creates booking with session_type='video_call_booking', GET /api/miniapp/my-bookings/{user_id} returns user's bookings, 2) Dashboard Video Bookings - GET /api/miniapp-manage/video-bookings returns bookings with stats, POST /api/miniapp-manage/booking-action handles schedule/start/complete/reject actions, 3) Private Messaging - POST /api/miniapp/chat/send creates messages, GET /api/miniapp/chat/history/{user_id} returns history, 4) Dashboard Chat - GET /api/miniapp-manage/chats returns conversations with unread counts, POST /api/miniapp-manage/chat/reply sends admin replies, 5) Live Stream - POST /api/miniapp-manage/start-live creates live session, POST /api/miniapp-manage/end-live ends it, GET /api/miniapp/active-live returns active stream, 6) WebSocket endpoints available at /api/ws/call/{room_id} and /api/ws/live/{session_id}, 7) Dashboard sidebar shows separate TELEGRAM BOT and MINI APP sections, 8) Mini App frontend has 5 tabs: Plans, Calls, Live, Chat, More. NOTE: WebRTC video calls require real camera/mic and cannot be fully tested in automation.
